headline: Arena Archery arrows now hang where they struck — merge awaiting one arena's re-arm
lede: An arrow fired up under a low canopy no longer teleports to the roof of the platform: it hangs tip-up from the underside, sways, and can be walked over and pulled back for ammo — the arcade-era honesty the title's own README called its oldest gap. The law and nine new proof gates ship on a draft PR; KNOCKBACK's duel tempo needs one doctrine re-arm before it merges.

notes.text: Economy-aware lift: corridor-canopy hits hang in the walker's pull row; deep-air canopies keep hoisting arrows so the quiver loop (#1685) still runs. Thick stone lintels finally hang in air instead of embedding mid-rock.

Measured root cause of the WIP hold: hanging shafts land in the foe's own scavenger row, self-supplying the loser bot and stretching KNOCKBACK duels past the heat gate. Diagnosis, three ranked options and byte-level receipts are written up in PR #2583 for the next hand.
Slot b shipped EXCITEBIKE EDIT TRACK (#2576): stamp your own course, save three customs, race them at TRACK 7+ — live on production now.
archerycheck grows its proof: nine UNDERSIDE gates and a thirteenth mutant (always-lift) that dies on schedule; the twelve old mutants and every HEAT/CLIMBS/FLUSH pin stay green.
